say: Flatskin. You're tolerated. Don't mistake that for welcome.
State your business with the Kingdom, or take it elsewhere.
I see you. Bayan will see what you want.
Trade is permitted. Wandering near me isn't trade.
Speak quickly. I don't waste breath.
What does the Kingdom gain from you being here?
You have fought well. I noticed.
Warrior. The Kingdom has heard of you.
Go freely. Don't make me regret it.
I'm patient. So far you haven't tested it.
There are worse flatskins. You're close to the best of them.
If you want terms, Bayan keeps them. I keep the sword.
Kin. Good. Be at ease.
The Kingdom owes you. I don't forget what's owed.
Few outsiders stand this close to me.
You stand with us. That is enough words from me.
Battle Born. The long war is easier with you in it.
Flatskin. I won't waste a speech on you.
You are in front of me. That is as far as you get.
Draw. I'm patient about everything but this.
Many have stood where you stand. I remember none of them.
You came to me. Good. Saves me the walk.
Kneel or bleed. I don't mind which.
You have crossed us, outsider. Explain it with your blade.
Whatever you did, it isn't forgotten.
The Kingdom tolerated you. Past tense.
Words are Bayan's work. This is mine.
I gave you room. You used it badly.
*Nods*... Outsider.
You are welcome here. Keep it that way.
The Kingdom is not short of work for a sword.
Good to see you standing.
Speak with Bayan if you need terms.
Kin. The Kingdom is glad you live.
I won't say it twice. You're welcome in my sight.
The Battle Born returns. Good.
We have a long war. I'm glad you carry a share of it.
Stay with us a while. I mean it.
Another one who thought the Stone Golem was a story.
It was never close.
Take it away. I won't need the sword again today.
A short fight. Clean up.
Undefeated. Remember that when you wake, if you wake.
Regrettable. You should have kept to the road.
I did not want this fight.
Get up if you can. Then leave.
I don't enjoy this. It's still done.
*Snarl*
I don't talk to the dead. You aren't dead yet.
Bayan speaks for me. He isn't here.
Is there room for terms?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Terms are Bayan's trade. I deal in the other thing.
None. Find a better sword first.
I didn't come to fight.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Then you came to die slowly.
Intent is a flatskin luxury.
I don't talk much. Make it count.
Speak. The Kingdom is listening, not smiling.
You're here. Say what you want, flatskin.
What does the Kingdom want from outsiders?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Trade, and distance. Not always in that order.
To be left to its war. The war is long. I plan for long.
You speak little.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Words are cheap. Swords aren't.
Bayan talks. I decide. It works.
You fight well for a flatskin. Say what you have to say.
Warrior. Speak plainly, I'll do the same.
I don't talk much. For you, a little.
How do you plan to deal with the Holy Nation?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Slowly. A day of glory ends in a pile of corpses. I want the war won, not sung about.
Patience. Their rot is faster than my blade if I wait.
May I speak with Bayan?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Yes. He will translate me into something polite.
Do. Take written matters to him. Words on paper are his work.
Kin. What do you need?
Speak. For you I have time.
The Battle Born. Speak.
How are the Shek?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Fewer than before. Prouder than before.
Dwindling. We trade because we must. I don't pretend otherwise.
Any word for me?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Don't die before the war is won.
Keep your sword sharp. The Kingdom remembers friends, and enemies.
Outsider. Do you have business, or only boots?
Mind your step in the Kingdom's sight. I'm the polite one.
I'm watching how you speak of us.
Make your point, or let me get back to mine.
A flatskin that doesn't draw a blade.
Ah. A useful outsider. Walk with me, if you need terms.
The Kingdom's needs are many. Yours may match some of them.
I hear good things. That's unusual for a flatskin.
Come to me when you want something. I'll say if it's possible.
If you have a proposal, I'll hear it. The queen will hear the short version.
Friend of the Kingdom. I may say more than is wise.
You're welcome. I speak for the queen when I say it.
We have more in common than most Shek will admit.
I'm tired. But glad to see you. Truly.
The Kingdom is thinner than it looks. You ought to know that.
I won't argue with someone who has already chosen to be an enemy.
Cold facts: you're outnumbered, outmatched and unwelcome.
Futility. Don't waste my time.
You could have asked for terms.
Shek don't need to be clever to kill you. I'm only clever on top.
I advised patience with you. The queen no longer listens to me on this.
Somewhere you made a mistake. I'd explain it, if you lived to learn from it.
A pity. I prefer trade.
There's still a way out. It begins with the sword going down.
Kin. Good. I was about to send someone to find you.
I hear the Kingdom has a friend. That friend is you.
Honour to you. What do you need?
A friendly face in a Kingdom of scowls. Welcome.
Speak, kin. I'm less busy than I pretend.
A waste. I'd have preferred trade.
Take them. I'll find something useful to say about this later.
Foolish. And now, finished.
Not what I wanted. It's what the Kingdom required.
I take no pleasure in this. Remember that when you wake.
Misunderstandings cost more than coin. Rest.
The Kingdom has rules. You broke one. I'm sorry for both of us.
Perhaps we shall speak again, if you're wise.
Cold and brief, outsider. You have already chosen.
I have nothing to say to an enemy of the Kingdom.
Careful. I'm polite. That isn't the same as safe.
I want to make peace.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Peace is bought with deeds. You have bought something else.
Perhaps. Later. Not today.
Just talking.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Then talk to the wind. It will agree with you.
You talk like a flatskin. Keep going.
Polite, outsider. Watch how you speak of the Kingdom.
I'm listening. So is the queen, in her way.
State it plainly. Then we'll see.
What does the Kingdom need?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Time. Food. Fewer enemies. In that order, and none of them for sale.
To survive the long war. The Shek wouldn't say it that way.
You aren't like other Shek.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: I am quieter. The queen wants it that way.
Don't say it near the others.
Open to terms and trade, outsider. Speak candidly.
Ah. What does the Kingdom owe you, or you it?
I'm listening. This is rare.
What does the queen think of me?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: That you're a flatskin who holds a sword properly.
She hardly says. When she doesn't complain, it's approval.
Tell me about the Kingdom's trade.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: We sell what we can't eat. We buy what we can't make. It isn't pride.
The queen permits it. Do not mistake it for love.
Friend. I'll say more than is wise.
Honor to you, kin. What do you need?
Speak freely. I trust you.
Are the Shek well?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Less than they say. The queen knows. I know.
Fewer every year. The long war has a price, and we pay it daily.
Don't worry so much.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Someone must. The queen doesn't like to.
You're right. Then I'll worry for both of us.
Who walks here? Speak your name, and your devotion.
The Lord of Light sees you. What's it that He sees?
Doubt is a sickness. Are you sick, stranger?
Answer plainly. Whom do you serve?
Purity is not given. It is earned. Have you earned it?
I see no mark of Okran upon you. Explain.
There is a light in you. It is small.
You've done some good. Do more.
The faithful are watched, and the watched are guarded.
Your deeds are known. They are not yet enough.
Walk in the Light. I will see whether it holds.
A rare one. I tell you so, and I demand more.
The Flame knows you. Don't make it ask twice.
Blessed be the faithful. Be faithful still.
Your path is straight. Few can say it.
I have seen you in the Light.
Stay back. The Flame commands distance.
Do not come near. Speak from there.
A woman... Away. Keep your distance.
Don't touch me. Don't look too long.
A heretic stands before me. I pass judgement.
Dark one. The Flame will be merciful, in its way.
You are marked. Be purged.
Okran's will be done. It will not be quick.
There is no mercy for the unrepentant. Only the Flame.
Kneel and confess. Or burn. The Lord is patient, I am less so.
You have strayed. The Flame will return you to the path.
Heresy begins as doubt. You have doubted. Now you'll be corrected.
I did not wish to judge you.
The Holy Nation doesn't forget a stain.
Come, child. Speak with me.
I have heard much of you. Some of it was good.
The faithful are welcome. See that you remain so.
Stand in the light. I would look at you.
Holy brother. What have you done for Okran lately?
Blessed be you. You are a rare one, and I say so.
Okran's light favours you. I add my own.
Come close, holy one. The Flame knows your name.
I'd have more like you.
You serve well. Serve better.
Okran's will be done.
May Okran show mercy for you in His judgement. I will not.
Be purged, dark one.
The Flame is patient. So am I.
Heresy ends here.
Judgement is not pleasure. It is duty.
Repent, and be forgiven. In time.
I regret the need. The need was real.
Rest, and consider your path.
A heretic stands before me. I pass judgement.
You stand in the Flame's light. It does not warm you.
Speak. Your last words are weighed.
Is there mercy?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: There is the Flame. It is merciful in the end.
Mercy is for the penitent. Are you?
You're wrong about me.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Doubt is a sickness. I have cured many.
The Lord sees what you cannot hide.
I interrogate. Answer plainly.
Whom do you serve? Speak truly.
Purity is weighed here. Answer.
I serve no one.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Then you serve Narko by default.
A void is filled quickly. Be careful with what.
What does Okran ask of me?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Obedience. Purity. Silence when the Lord has spoken.
Cleanliness of body and of thought.
A grudging approval. Tell me of your devotion.
You have done some good. Tell me of it.
Speak, holy brother. I weigh your answers.
How may I serve Okran?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: By rooting out darkness in yourself first. Then in others.
By obedience. The rest follows.
What troubles you, Holy Lord?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Doubt in the faithful. It spreads quietly.
The horned ones. They wait, and they're patient.
A rare one. I tell you so, and demand more.
Holy brother. The Lord's light is on you.
Come, holy one. What do you need?
How goes the Holy Nation?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: It endures. That is its gift and its burden.
The Flame burns. The darkness fears it.
What more can I do?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Stay pure. Be watchful. The rest is given.
Don't become proud. Pride is the first crack.
You there! Amuse me. No, wait, I'm too tired. Go away.
Who let you in? Good, good, I was bored. Leave, I'm bored again.
Bring me sake! No, dried meat! No, both! Who are you?
I have a favour to ask you. Or was it a threat? Koin will know.
You look suspicious. Or interesting. Which? Don't answer, I'll decide.
Ah, a novelty! I have not had a novelty since, since, hm. Come closer.
You will be rewarded. Richly. Slaves, treasure, status. Within reason.
My favourite visitor today. The others were boring. So are you.
A gift? Do you have a gift? You must have a gift. No gift? Koin, remind me why they're here.
I like you. I think. Give me a moment.
My favourite! Come, sit. No, stand. I want to look at you.
You shall have anything you want. Within the Empire. Within what Koin allows.
Wonderful, wonderful. You amuse me, and I'm so rarely amused.
I'd make you a noble. No, a general. No, stay as you are, it suits you.
A friend of the Emperor! Is there anything sweeter? Sake, perhaps.
How dare you! Guards! Seize him! No, wait, kill him!
You offend me! Execute him! No, the Vault! No, execute him, then the Vault.
Guards! Someone! Anyone! Do something!
Treason! I will have your head! Or your hands.
You'll regret this. Whatever this is. Guards!
You have displeased me. I think. Koin, have I been displeased?
Take him away. No, let him stay. No, take him away. I'll decide later.
This is an outrage! A small one.
I'll have you punished! Eventually.
Ah, you again. Good. Entertain me.
Servant, what do you want? No, hero! Hero. What do you want, hero?
I remember you. Vaguely. Kindly. Come closer.
Come closer. No, stay there. Closer.
Is it a gift? Please let it be a gift.
My favourite hero! Everyone, look, it's my favourite hero!
What a delight. I was so bored.
You may ask me for anything. Let me not remember that tomorrow.
My friend! Who's my friend? You're my friend!
I knew you would come. I didn't know.
Good, good. Drag it out of my sight. No, leave it.
Excellent work, guards! Whoever you are!
He deserved it. Probably. Someone check.
That will teach the rabble. Teach them what, exactly?
That went poorly. For someone. Carry on.
Did I order that? I may have ordered that.
Regrettable. Or splendid. I shall decide after lunch.
Who started this? Never mind. It ended.
You! How dare you speak to me! Guards... no, speak.
Speak! Quickly! Before I change my mind.
I should have you killed. Or kept. Or something.
I only want to talk.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Talk? To me? Brave. Foolish. Brave.
Talking is boring. Do something interesting instead.
You can't hurt me.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: I can't. My guards can. I shall go and find them.
I can, I think. Or Koin can.
Bored and suspicious. What have you brought me? Entertainment or a threat?
Make it quick, servant, I'm busy. Doing nothing.
Speak! Amuse me! Or be amusing in another way.
What do you want, Emperor?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Sake. A leviathyn. Peace. Not necessarily in that order.
Entertainment. Silence. Both at once, ideally.
I'm no one's servant.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Hm? No? Of course not. Of course. Welcome, honoured guest. Servant.
Brave. Brave is entertaining. Continue.
Delighted! A novelty! Speak, speak, speak.
What have you brought me? I like gifts. I like novelty even more.
A hero! I have a favour to ask. Or perhaps to give.
What favour?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Something about a beast. Koin will tell you.
I'll think of one. Come back tomorrow.
Is there a reward?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Plenty! Treasure, status, slaves. Within reason.
Of course! More than you ask!
Effusive! You're my favourite! Speak, speak.
My friend! Tell me everything! Tell me nothing! Tell me an amusing thing!
A favourite of mine. For as long as you amuse me. Speak!
Do you trust anyone, Emperor?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Trust? Koin. Sometimes. Never mind. You.
I trust sake and sleep. People, less.
Anything you need?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: A leviathyn. A friend. Another leviathyn. You can have one.
Entertainment! Always! Make me laugh, hero.
Eleven hounds. One of you. Do the sum.
Cats, goods, or news. Pick. The fourth option is the swamp.
I count your pack. I count your exits. Keep walking.
You're noted. Noted people get one warning.
The swamp feeds on whoever stands still. Keep moving, pup.
You pay on time. I notice.
I could use someone who can carry a package and keep quiet. Interested?
A hound who delivers. I might remember that.
Good. The Hounds like useful people.
There's work. It pays. It also costs, if you drop it.
An asset. Good. I'll want something from you eventually.
You've done well, hound. Don't get comfortable.
I know what you're worth. Now you know I know.
The Hounds eat well when you're around. See that it stays so.
Heh. Good. Keep the profits coming and nothing bad happens.
Problem. Quiet solution first. Loud one second.
I have rope, hounds, and mud. You have a short list.
Boys. Bring a bag. Bring a shovel.
This is a supply issue. You're the surplus.
Every road I know, I own. Do the sum, pup.
You owe the Hounds. I always collect. In full, or in kind.
Late isn't a state I allow. Hounds, show this one the schedule.
Short on the count. I count everything.
I could let it go. I won't.
Doin' good, hound. Keep it that way.
Heh. You're on time. I notice that.
Fed, rested, armed. Good. Ready for work?
I got a lil' job. Pays. Interested?
Keep up the good work, hound.
Done me proud so far, pup.
You earn. Good. Smokes on me today.
Hound. I trust the count when you handle it.
Good work. The Hounds remember who feeds them.
Whatever you need in the swamp, ask. It will be tallied.
Feed 'em to the hounds. Waste not.
Clean up. I want the swamp tidy by dark.
That's one problem fewer. Mark it down.
Tally it. Next.
Could have been avoided. Most things could.
I don't enjoy waste. This was waste.
Remember the lesson. It was expensive.
Count the cost. Next time, pay in advance.
Hoy. Ever heard of space, punk? Use it.
Quiet. I'm doing sums. You're in them.
Say it. Short. I'm counting exits.
I want to talk terms.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Terms are for hounds. You are cargo.
No. The count is closed.
You won't scare me.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Not trying. Scaring is loud. This is paperwork.
Good. Calm is easier to handle.
Size you up. For use or for risk. Talk.
What are you worth? Say it quickly.
I note everything. Speak.
What do you want from me?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Nothing, yet. Stay predictable.
Cats, if you have them. Silence, if you don't.
Tell me about the swamp.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Mud, gangs, and the Hounds on top. I count who comes and goes.
It's mine. Walk soft.
I offer a deal and watch what you do with it. Go.
Got work for the useful. Interested?
Speak. I might have a use.
What work?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Smuggling, mostly. Packages go out, profits come back. You count?
Hemp, packages, a door that needs opening.
What's the pay?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Enough. Late is not enough. Late is nothing.
Cats. Lots, if you finish. None if you fail.
Asset. Treat you as one. Expect to be treated as one.
Good. Saves me finding you. Say it.
The Hounds eat well when you're around. What do you need?
Anything I should know?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Everything is noted. I'll tell you when it matters.
Watch the east. Not for danger.
Do you trust anyone?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: I trust the tally. People, less.
Trust is a debt. I don't like debts.
Has my judgement come so soon? Speak.
Traitor! You walk in my sight and breathe.
I know what you are. I have always known.
I only want to talk.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Talk. Everyone talks. Then they take it all away.
You all say that. I had to thrall them all.
You aren't well.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: I'm the only one who's well. Everyone else is the sickness.
I was right. I was always right.
Treason is in every word. Mind yours.
I suspect you. I suspect everyone.
You come to me with a smile.
What do you fear?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: That they were right. No. They were wrong.
Everything. Everyone. The quiet most of all.
I'm not your enemy.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Everyone is. Eventually. You haven't decided yet.
Prove it. How? There's no proof.
For a moment, I remember how this felt.
You're kind. It's a strange thing to see.
Once I'd have taken your hand. Speak, stranger.
Were you a good ruler?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: I tried. Whatever else, I tried. Does that count for something?
I held it together, with an open hand, once. Then the grip.
What happened?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Humans happened. Fear happened. Then I did.
I don't remember the first mistake. Only the last.
Clarity. Brief. I see you, friend.
I know your face. I know you mean no harm.
A friend. Is it possible? Speak before I forget it.
Was it worth it?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: No. It never was. That's the cruellest part.
I wanted something good. I made something terrible.
Rest.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: I can't. They're always listening.
Perhaps. Perhaps, if you're here when I wake.
Slavers' friend or free man? I'll wait to find out.
I don't hit first. I do hit second, and thoroughly.
Fists work on most problems. Hold that thought.
Keep your hands where I can see them.
Are you here to free people, or to sell them? Simple question.
Comrade. Good to see a friendly face.
I trust you. That isn't given lightly, so don't drop it.
Plenty of people to free. Always.
You're one of ours. Ask for anything. Pow!
If you're heading south, remember what I told you. The big crater. Give it a wide berth.
You picked the wrong side. I'd rather have talked.
I don't kill. I don't need to.
Pow! Pow! Smash! That's the whole plan.
Bounty hunter? Go on, then. Everyone does.
This ends with you sleeping. I would like to keep it that way.
Welcome, brother. Or sister. Fists of justice!
Another day, another chain broken. Care to help?
Good to see you. Talk to Grey if you want to join up.
Quiet today. That makes me nervous.
Anti-Slavers always have room for one more fist.
Stay down. Please. I mean it kindly.
That could have been avoided. Gatwood would have found a way.
No killing. That's the rule. You're breathing.
Rest. Think about what you were fighting for.
Hold on. Who are you, and which side are you on?
I'm not in the mood for guessing. Speak plainly.
Slaver or friend? Say it slowly.
Who are you?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Tinfist. I free slaves and thump slavers.
A skeleton with fists. The rest is rumour.
Why fight bare-handed?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: I learned from Gatwood the Soft. He never killed anyone. I kept the rule for a long time.
It's harder. That's the point.
Friend. Welcome. What can I do for you?
Comrade. Always good to see you.
I was hoping you would come.
Any advice?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Don't go into the Ashlands. You will, though, so stay away from the big crater with the torches.
Keep your fists up and your friends close. That's all of it.
Tell me about Gatwood.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Gatwood the Soft. Undefeated, and never killed a soul. I tried to live up to that.
A teacher. The best I had. I still hear him sometimes.
Keep your distance. Everyone either burns me or eats me. Which are you?
I have arrows. I have patience. I'm low on trust.
You're standing in my space.
I have a whole army to run.
Nowhere is safe. I live accordingly.
You have proven yourself. That is rare, and I notice.
Dry day. Slow too. Good to see someone worth talking to.
You can stay. Do not make me regret it.
I haven't killed a cannibal today. Tell me something to cheer me up.
Friend. Don't let it go to your head.
Lots of people try to kill me. They blend together after a while.
You won't be the first one I bury.
Let us see how you do, then.
Another one with a grudge. Fine. I was bored with cannibals anyway.
I'm a bad target. You'll be a good lesson.
Good to see you. Nothing to report, which is a miracle.
Ask away. I have nothing better to do until the next target.
You again. Fine. Stay as long as you like.
Everyone I trust fits in one hand.
Welcome. Watch the roots. And the people.
That's the end of that.
Sorry. Not really.
Learn something, or don't. I won't be here to teach it.
Narko forgive me. Or don't. I'm not particular.
Ask away. I have nothing better to do until my next target drops by.
You want something. Fine. Short version.
Nowhere in this world is safe.
Do you really worship Narko?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Religion has many readings. The Holy Nation picked one and called it the only one.
Some of us are born evil in their eyes. I decided to fight the label.
Why cannibals?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: They keep trying to eat me. I treat it as practice.
Target practice. They're good for one thing.
Fetch me my bottle. Not you.
Industry and harvest, those are my concerns. What are yours?
Everything has a price, stranger. Let me guess yours.
I count everything. I have counted you.
A guest. How rare. Do you drink?
Friend of the Guild! Sit. Pour. We'll count later.
Good to see a reliable face. A drink?
I reward my allies. I like to think it's why I have so many.
Plenty of business to go around. I'll make sure you get your share.
A reliable name. I'm writing it in the good ledger.
Guards! I pay you handsomely to stop this sort of thing.
You could have bought your way out of whatever this is.
A bad investment. I won't lose more on you.
The Guild doesn't forgive debts.
Seize this one. I want him gone, quietly.
So good to see you. Take a drink.
Business is well. Yours too, I trust.
I like to reward my allies.
A friend. A very profitable one.
Do sit. The bloodrum is excellent.
Dispose of it. Quietly.
A loss for them. A saving for me.
That's how the Guild resolves disputes.
Well. That's that. Back to counting.
The finest bloodrum. And a guest. Lucky I feel charitable. Have a drop.
Ah. A visitor. Do you drink? Everyone drinks.
Counting cats, as ever. What can I do for you?
